title: PARALLELPERIOD of two dates in different months returns both whole months, shifted
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = PARALLELPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], -1, MONTH ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] IN { DATE ( 2024, 2, 1 ), DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) } )

source.quote: January and February of 2019 for MONTH (our input dates are within February and March 2019).
source.supports: the article gets the same result from the range February 1 to March 10 and from just those two dates: the two previous whole months

source.quote: shifts the first date and the last date the specified number of intervals, and then returns all contiguous dates between the two shifted dates

derivation: The two dates are in February and March 2024. The months are completed (February 1 to March 31) and moved back one month: January 1 to February 29, 31 + 29 = 60 days. Sales: Jan 300 + Feb 700 = 1000.
